data_size_verdict: SMALL: about 0.19M tokens of text (yours and other people's). A 13.7M-parameter model would want roughly 274M tokens to train well from scratch, so these messages alone are about 0.1% of that. Enough to copy your STYLE (length, slang, emoji habits) after pretraining, not enough to learn language from scratch. Plan: pretrain on public text, then fine-tune on your messages for a few epochs and watch the validation loss: it will start rising when the model begins memorising.
